personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal (with Indian aesthetic and Calm-like premium feel)
personality_one_liner: A calm, deeply spiritual, and culturally rooted sanctuary that feels like a quiet temple at dawn.

spacing.rule: Use strict 8pt grid. Generous breathing room, mimicking a serene temple space.

do's: Use glass headers over scrolling content (like meditation lists).
Use glass bottom tab bar so list content scrolls gracefully beneath.
Use frosted overlay on hero cards with imagery.
dont's: Don't use glass on body content or form inputs.
Don't blur heavily if the background is solid colored.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A welcoming center for daily spiritual check-ins, recommendations, and Guru's wisdom.

states.error: Soft text: 'Take a deep breath. Let's try to reconnect.' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'AATHMAN' logo and SOS floating action button. Top section: Mood check-in emojis. Middle section: Daily Recommendations horizontal scroll. Bottom sections: Message from Guru card (image + text) and Quote of the Day. Use glass header. Safe area top.

screens.name: Meditation Library
screens.layout: Categorized tabs (All, Sleep, Anxiety, Focus). Grid or list of meditation sessions. Each card has a background image with a vertical gradient scrim, title, and duration. Tapping opens Meditation Detail / Audio Player.

screens.name: Dear Diary

states.empty: Illustration of a blank book, 'Start your spiritual journey today'.

screens.layout: Calendar view at top. List of past entries below. FAB to add new entry. Writing screen has mood emoji picker, date, and large text area.

screens.name: My Stats & Rank
screens.layout: Top section: Mantra Jaap Counter (large tap area, haptic feedback). Middle: Stats dashboard (sessions, minutes). Bottom: Rank leaderboard with tabs (Circle, State, National, International).

screens.name: Live Satsang & Yoga
screens.purpose: Join live spiritual and physical wellness sessions.

states.empty: No live sessions right now. View schedule.

screens.layout: List of large cards featuring event images, title, time, and 'Join Now' button. Uses image gradient scrims.

meditation_hero.alt: Silhouette of meditating person at sunset

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the Indian aesthetic is reflected through typography (Cormorant Garamond for displays) and the rich but calm color palette (Saffron, Purple, Teal on warm cream backgrounds).
Implement the 'Dear Diary' with a calendar view and the mood tracking bar chart (Calm/Happy/Grateful/Anxious) as requested.
The Mantra Jaap Counter must have a very large, prominent tap area with `haptics.mantra_counter_tap` mapped to it.
Always use gradient scrims (bottom 30-40% dark) over images (like the meditation thumbnails or live satsang cards) to guarantee text readability.
Keep the SOS Depression button prominent on the Home screen or globally, potentially as a floating glass card or a sticky footer above the tab bar.
Do NOT use heavy shadows. Rely on spacing and subtle borders to separate content, matching the calm, airy feel of Headspace/Calm.
